report.explanation: Alert claims checkout health degraded, but current telemetry shows healthy gateway and order metrics (p95 72ms, error rate 0.0012, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters). Order shows high retained heap after GC with 7 WARN occurrences, but a single snapshot without a chronological retention series cannot establish a leak, and no evidence links it to checkout degradation. Insufficient to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Chronological memory-retention series for order service to establish a sustained growth trend rather than a single snapshot
Baseline/prior memory_retained_bytes for order to quantify growth magnitude
Latency or error-rate evidence tying order memory retention to checkout degradation
Evidence of checkout-path impact (elevated p95/error rate) beyond the flat 72ms and 0.0012 error rate observed
